name: Iconset · Free Icons · Iconset

title.zh: Iconset · Free Icons · 比较图标包样张

description.zh: 对照细描边与留白，再核原包许可和导入条件。 Iconset 的图标包样张目录，展示不同图标集的封面、作者和导入说明。本次查看 InVision Essentials 与 Feather 的真实样张；Feather Icon Pack 页面声明该包免费，导入要求先安装桌面 app，其费用与原图标包完整许可未核实，本次没有运行 app 或取得图标包。
description.en: Iconset’s icon-pack specimen directory, with pack covers, designers, and import instructions. This visit examined real previews for InVision Essentials and Feather. The Feather Icon Pack page says the pack is free; importing requires the desktop app, whose costs and the original pack’s full license remain unverified. The app was not run and no icon package was obtained.

reconstructionPrompt:
Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by Iconset · Free Icons (https://iconset.io/icons).
Technology stack: React, Tailwind CSS, TypeScript.
Component specification: 对照细描边与留白，再核原包许可和导入条件。

Visual details from source observation: 我们在目录先看到三个图标包入口，再开 InVision，对照信封、电话和货车的线框与彩色版本。建议继续看 Feather 的细描边样张，比较转角与留白，再决定选哪一包；两页都写明先安装 Iconset app。我们只查看了网页样张与导入说明，没有运行桌面管理器，app 费用也未核实，目录的免费宣传不替代原图标包许可。
Ensure clean semantic markup, fully accessible ARIA roles and keyboard interactions, responsive layout across desktop and mobile, crisp typography, and fluid state transitions (default, hover, active, focus).

offers.scope: Iconset 目录当前 Feather Icon Pack 单包 offer；导入依赖 Iconset 桌面 app，app 费用与原包授权另核。

pricing.quote: Feather is a collection of simply beautiful SVG icons, that you can grab all for free.
